ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white-to-light-grey pixels across the interior surface with a sharp contrast to low-intensity black borders and focal spotting.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity central region; low-intensity vertical column extending from the median notch down; peripheral low-intensity banding along the trailing and leading edges; scattered circular low-intensity blobs (mottling) throughout the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body and an acute interior pixel angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge characterized by small-amplitude peaks and valleys; more pronounced jagged protrusions visible at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, extending symmetrically to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and oval-shaped low-intensity pixel clusters (scars) distributed across the light surface, with approximately 5-6 prominent clusters on the left lobe and 4-5 on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of dark, thin linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the upper-left lobe and vertically oriented marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-contrast bumps on the outermost distal tips indicating barnacle colonization; significant serration and potential minor trauma along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Embedded high-contrast alphanumeric metadata at the bottom of the frame reading JAC98-57/14, ID 10817, JOHN CALAMBOKIDIS, S# N1-39, and 06 Oct 98 Point St. George.
